overall: MARGINAL overall: breezy now, easing 4–9 PM, showers about 9 PM–midnight
limiterDetail: The main limiter is wind , with rain tonight and a current pickup overnight. Ciron is 16 kt now (gusts 21) and stays 11–15 kt through Sunday morning. Nangalao 14 kt, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Alava and Binudac 13 kt, Barangonan 12 kt now, all easing to 6–10 kt about 4–9 PM. Showers about 9 PM–midnight are heaviest at Maglalambay and Panlaitan. Currents pick up at Tara and Turda this evening and in the western grounds before dawn Sunday.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA (latest entries are Davao Region gale advisories). The feed still carries a tropical cyclone alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) that doesn't name Palawan; worth a glance on the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: The recovery slips a day: Tuesday 3 supply is back to SLIGHTLY SOFT (was near normal this morning). Monday now looks breezier (11 kt, gusts 17, was 9.4 kt gusts 15), though still dry, and Tuesday too (11 kt, was 8.7), so Wednesday 4 is now near normal and the firm return to normal comes Thursday 5.

Today and tomorrow are unchanged: Sat 31 NEAR NORMAL , Sun 1 SLIGHTLY SOFT , Mon 2 SOFT dip (Sunday is still the wettest day at 12.7 mm, a little drier than this morning's 15.9). This afternoon's grounds read 3 GOOD / 12 MARGINAL / 1 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (this morning 7 GOOD / 8 MARGINAL / 1 POOR), because the 2 PM breeze is 10–16 kt with gusts near 20. It eases from about 4 PM. PAGASA shows no warning for Palawan.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). The dashboard's shortage detector stays ELEVATED for Sat–Fri (guide only). Tightening risk now runs three days, Sunday through Tuesday arrivals (this morning it was Sunday and Monday). Stock up from today's and Sunday's landings, and lean on Panlaitan, Maglalambay, Galoc and the Coron side.
